description: This file contains unit tests for the MailStats class in the Goteo project's email metrics module. It tests instantiation, validation, metric incrementing, and retrieval of mail statistics.

classes.name: MailStatsTest
classes.description: PHPUnit test class for testing the MailStats functionality within the Goteo email metrics framework.

methods.name: testInstance
methods.description: Tests instantiation of the MailStats class.

methods.name: testValidate
methods.description: Tests the validation logic of the MailStats object.

methods.name: testIncMetric
methods.description: Tests the incrementing of metrics, including exception handling and proper creation.

methods.name: testGetList
methods.description: Tests retrieval of MailStats entries associated with a specific mail ID.
